converter.description: Transforms input from one format to another

merger.description: Combines multiple inputs into a single output

splitter.description: Splits a single input into multiple outputs

extractor.description: Extracts specific content from an input

generator.description: Creates output without requiring a document input

editor.description: Modifies content in-place within a document

optimizer.description: Reduces size or improves quality of input

reader.description: Reads and parses structured data from input

writer.description: Writes structured data to output format

recognizer.description: Recognizes patterns or content in input

renderer.description: Renders visual output from structured input
